def.name: RelapseBiopsyStatus_BiopsyConfirmedDlbcl
def.display: Biopsy confirmed DLBCL (repeat IHC completed)

def.name: RelapseBiopsyStatus_TransformationIndolent
def.display: Transformed from prior indolent lymphoma (e.g. transformed FL)

def.name: RelapseBiopsyStatus_BiopsyPending
def.display: Biopsy pending / FNAC only (repeat core/excisional biopsy mandatory)

def.name: RelapseTiming_RelapseGt12m
def.display: Late relapse (> 12 months post completion of first-line R-CHOP)

def.name: RelapseTiming_RelapseLe12m
def.display: Early relapse (<= 12 months post completion of first-line R-CHOP)

def.name: RelapseTiming_PrimaryRefractory
def.display: Primary refractory / progression ON first-line R-CHOP therapy

def.name: ChemoFitnessOverall_ChemoEligible
def.display: Chemotherapy eligible (candidate for intensive or standard combination salvage)

def.name: ChemoFitnessOverall_UnfitAllChemo
def.display: Unfit for combination chemotherapy (candidate for palliative / oral metronomic / targeted only)

def.name: AsctFitness_AsctFit
def.display: Fit for intensive salvage therapy + Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT)

def.name: AsctFitness_AsctUnfit
def.display: Not fit for ASCT (non-transplant candidate)

def.name: CarTFitness_CarTFit
def.display: Fit for CAR-T cell therapy (tolerable CRS/ICANS risk, adequate organ reserve)

def.name: CarTFitness_CarTUnfit
def.display: Not fit for CAR-T cell therapy

def.name: PetResponseSalvage_SalvageCrPr
def.display: Chemosensitive: PR or CR (Deauville Score 1-3, >= 50% reduction in uptake)

def.name: PetResponseSalvage_SalvageDs4Partial
def.display: Partial response / residual uptake (Deauville Score 4, no new disease sites)

def.name: PetResponseSalvage_SalvageDs5Refractory
def.display: Chemotherapy-refractory (Deauville Score 5 or progressive disease)

def.name: PetResponseSalvage_NotAssessed
def.display: Not yet assessed / salvage therapy not yet completed

def.name: CarTFuturePlan_CartPossible
def.display: CAR-T is planned or remains a future possibility (MANDATORY TO AVOID BENDA / POLA-BR)

def.name: CarTFuturePlan_CartDefinitivelyExcluded
def.display: CAR-T is definitively NOT planned / patient ineligible / unavailable

def.name: CellOfOriginRr_NonGcb
def.display: Non-GCB phenotype (eligible for targeted lenalidomide / bortezomib)

def.name: CellOfOriginRr_Gcb
def.display: GCB phenotype

def.name: DominantResidualSite_SingleSiteResidual
def.display: Single residual PET+ site OR initial bulky site (candidate for consolidative RT 30-36 Gy)

def.name: DominantResidualSite_DiffuseMultisite
def.display: Diffuse widespread multi-site disease (systemic therapy only)

def.name: DominantResidualSite_NoResidualCmr
def.display: Complete metabolic response (no residual uptake)

element.value: Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT to identify highest SUVmax biopsy site
Image-guided core needle or surgical excisional biopsy of dominant lesion
Repeat immunohistochemistry panel (CD20, CD10, BCL6, MUM1, MYC, BCL2)
Baseline 2D-ECHO (LVEF) & Viral screening (HBsAg, HBcAb, HCV, HIV)
R-GEMOX x 3 cycles (Rituximab 375 mg/m2 D1, Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 D1,8, Oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2 D1 q14d)
Alternative: R-GDP x 3 cycles (Rituximab, Gemcitabine, Dexamethasone, Cisplatin/Carboplatin)
Alternative: Pola-R-GEMOX x 3 cycles (Polatuzumab vedotin + R-GEMOX)
Mandatory 18F-FDG PET-CT response evaluation after cycle 3
Peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) mobilization (G-CSF +/- Plerixafor) and apheresis harvest
High-dose conditioning chemotherapy (BEAM regimen: Carmustine, Etoposide, Cytarabine, Melphalan)
Autologous stem cell transplantation and post-transplant supportive care
Consolidative ISRT 30-36 Gy to single residual or initial presentation bulky site post-ASCT
Targeted biopsy of residual FDG-avid mass to verify viable lymphoma vs inflammatory necrosis
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board review for CAR-T eligibility vs consolidative RT
Urgent referral to CAR-T certified cellular therapy center
Anti-CD19 CAR-T cell infusion (Axi-cel, Tisa-cel, or Liso-cel)
Non-bendamustine bridging therapy (R-GEMOX or localized RT)
R-GEMOX / R-GDP / Pola-R-GEMOX x 3 cycles -> if responding complete 6 cycles total
Note: Carboplatin replaces cisplatin in R-GDP for renal impairment
Consolidative RT (30-36 Gy) to single residual or bulky presentation site post-chemotherapy
T-cell leukapheresis for anti-CD19 CAR-T manufacturing (Axi-cel / Tisa-cel / Liso-cel)
Bridging therapy: R-GEMOX or Pola-R-GEMOX or dominant-site RT (STRICTLY AVOID BENDAMUSTINE)
Pre-infusion lymphodepleting chemotherapy: Fludarabine (30 mg/m2 D1-3) + Cyclophosphamide (300 mg/m2 D1-3)
Anti-CD19 CAR-T cell infusion with mandatory inpatient CRS and ICANS neurotoxicity monitoring
Obinutuzumab pre-treatment (1000 mg IV on D-7 of Cycle 1) to deplete circulating B cells and mitigate CRS
Glofitamab step-up dosing (2.5 mg D8, 10 mg D15 of Cycle 1, then 30 mg D1 Cycle 2 onwards)
Gemcitabine (1000 mg/m2) + Oxaliplatin (100 mg/m2) chemotherapy backbone
Alternative if Glofitamab unavailable: R-GEMOX / R-GDP x 6 cycles
Polatuzumab vedotin (1.8 mg/kg D1) + Bendamustine (90 mg/m2 D1,2) + Rituximab (375 mg/m2 D1) x 6 cycles q28d
Prophylactic G-CSF support in every cycle
Oral Lenalidomide (20-25 mg daily D1-21 q28d +/- Rituximab)
Palliative symptom care, pain management, and transfusion support
Palliative radiotherapy to localized painful or symptomatic sites
Best supportive care: pain control, nutritional support, palliative care team co-management
Oral metronomic chemotherapy (e.g. low-dose oral etoposide 50 mg/m2 or oral cyclophosphamide)
Palliative RT for localized bleeding, bone pain, or mass obstruction
Consolidative ISRT 30-36 Gy delivered to single residual FDG-avid lesion or initial presentation bulk
